description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

California State Polytechnic University-Pomona is hiring a Web Developer I to develop, maintain, and support web applications, APIs, and related systems. The role also contributes to technology research, project delivery, application performance and security, and technical documentation and user support.
Web Developer I developing, deploying, and maintaining web applications and APIs; supporting security, accessibility, performance, and production operations

Responsibilities:
• Develop, enhance, test, deploy, and maintain web applications, APIs, and related processes using established technical specifications and development standards. Support application security, reliability, accessibility, and performance to meet established business requirements
• Assist with researching, evaluating, testing, and implementing emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), under technical guidance to improve productivity, user experience, and operational efficiency. Document findings and provide input on potential applications and best practices for using AI tools
• Work with functional and technical stakeholders to assist with analyzing business processes, gathering and documenting requirements, coordinating testing, and implementing approved technical solutions. Support assigned project activities using established procedures
• Monitor application performance, troubleshoot routine issues, implement approved security updates and performance enhancements, support accessibility compliance, perform code maintenance, support production operations, and escalate complex issues as needed
• Develop technical documentation, provide support to users or technical staff as needed, stay current on web development technologies, accessibility standards, security practices, and participate in continuous professional development

Requirements:
• Combination - Equivalent to a bachelor's degree in a related field. Relevant education and/or experience which demonstrates acquired and successfully applied knowledge and abilities shown above may be substituted for the required education on a year-for-year basis
• General knowledge of web development design principles, concepts, practices, and frameworks
• General knowledge of user experience concepts and principles and technology platforms
• General knowledge of accessibility standards, guidelines, and regulations, as well as using accessibility evaluation tools and software
• Demonstrated knowledge and ability to apply web and mobile application design concepts
• Organizational and time management skills to plan, organize, and prioritize work
• Demonstrated communication and interpersonal skills to gather information from users, communicate technical issues effectively, document processes, and draft user/developer guides
• Ability to maintain confidentiality and appropriately handle sensitive information
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team as well as build relationships with diverse stakeholders
• Analytical skills to gather data and information, test website performance issues, and resolve website and web application issues and problems
• Computer skills to appropriately design websites and use relevant software packages as required

Preferred:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
• Experience with web application development using modern programming languages and frameworks
• Knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and version control (Git)
• Familiarity with responsive design, web accessibility (WCAG), and secure coding practices
• Exposure to AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) and interest in applying AI to improve development and automation
• Strong analytical, communication, and teamwork skills
• Higher education or enterprise application development experience is a plus
